action.text: Task: Add regression tests for port access on urlsplit/urlparse results. Implementation (parse.py:177-185): port property checks isdigit()+isascii(), raises ValueError('Port could not be cast to integer value as {port!r}') for non-digit/non-ASCII, then checks 0<=port<=65535, raises ValueError('Port out of range 0-65535'). Error occurs at .port access, not construction. Empty port ('' after colon) is stored as None by _hostinfo (not port → port=None), so .port returns None, NOT an error. Cases: None→None, ''→None (same as no port), 0→0, 65535→65535, 65536→range error, -1→cast error, abc→cast error, \u0966→cast error (not ASCII). Bytes: same logic. Candidate: 918f0684. Test sha: d25ffa0e. Fix: move empty port to valid assertions (assertIsNone), remove from invalid lists. Then doc file.
